messages:
maria: Heads-up — rollout of rfc/quant-int8-kernel landed in prod at 09:07 and we're seeing a 20-30% p50 latency regression on short-chat routes. rolling back in progress.

luis: ack, saw the alert. Is this the new dequant path change? I remember a perf note in the PR about an extra memcpy for mixed-precision.

hamid: from quick profile: yes, dequant path adds a dequantize kernel pass that runs on CPU before batching. attached probe shows CPU spike at dequant step for seq_len <= 64.

samantha: CI perf job (perf/inference/shortseq) failed on the merge — threshold breach at 12:34 UTC, job output: "p50 baseline=24.3ms new=31.8ms (+31%)". CI bot attached the flamegraph link.

ci-bot: [perf-test] perf/inference/shortseq failed: threshold_exceeded. Build: rfc/quant-int8-kernel@b6f9d3. Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/1748802134/flame.svg

maria: thanks — can someone run a bisect between b6f9d3 and previous commit? suspect f9a02a7 where kernel selection heuristic changed to prefer int8-path for 4-bit models.

luis: running local bisect now. quick note: kernel chooser now uses "tensor_size_ratio" heuristic that favors int8 kernels when sparse dims present. Might cause dequant to trigger for small batches.

hamid: paste of perf diff from local repro:
```
+ dequant_kernel:    18.2ms -> 28.9ms  (+58%)
+ memcpy_cpu:         3.5ms  -> 7.1ms   (+103%)
- fp32_attention:     12.7ms -> 8.9ms   (-30%)
```
looks like attention improved slightly but dequant overhead killed us on short sequences.

samantha: @maria this is a rollout blocker for dedicated customers on low-latency plans. I'd keep the rollback until we have a fix or tuned heuristic. :warning:

maria: agree — rolling back to a8c3d1 (pre-heuristic change). Please open a follow-up to gate kernel selection by seq_len and batch_size. Also add a CI perf test that exercises seq_len 8/16/32.

luis: created PR: fixes/quant-kernel-guard (description: guard int8 selection behind runtime checks; add sequence-length cutoff; improved dequant memcpy -> gpu memcpy attempt). benchmark notes in PR.

hamid: quick experiment: modified kernel chooser to prefer fp16 for seq_len < 64 or batch_size < 4; local p50 back to baseline. But quality check needed — int8 enabled for longer sequences still.

oncall: FYI, alerting rules adjusted to include dequant CPU usage metric so we catch regressions earlier. added a shortseq perf dashboard panel. :thumbsup:

maria: leaving a note for release: quantify tradeoff in the ticket (perf delta vs accuracy regression). we need an eval run on the same prompt set to ensure no unacceptable quality drop when reverting to fp16 for short seqs.

samantha: CC @support — will communicate to customers impacted by the brief latency spike and rollback.

luis: final note — flagged potential memory-copy optimization: if we can keep dequant on-GPU (no CPU memcpy) we might retain fp32-attn win without the dequant penalty. adding to infra follow-up.
